notes.title: Skies Full, Hearts Full – Thank You, 20,000 Times
notes.content:
Hey Commanders!

Today’s a huge milestone! We’re just about to welcome our 20,000th Commander to the ranks! 🎉

Getting to build the game I used to daydream about as a kid with such an awesome community is something truly special. I'm beyond grateful for the way you’ve embraced Metal Thunder and shared your feedback across Discord, Steam discussions, and even email, it’s been invaluable.

Quick SITREP: I’ve been a bit quiet lately due to moving apartments and then getting knocked out by an illness right after. But I’m back on my feet and fully back at work!

Thanks to all of you, I’ve got a solid list of bugs to blast away with the 45mm and a ton of great QoL suggestions. Luckily, nothing game-breaking as of now, but before I roll out fixes and polish, I’ve jumped headfirst into a major content update. (It may or may not involve zombies. 🧟)

So please bear with me on the minor bugs for a bit longer and here’s a small sneak peek at what’s coming next:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192417/51fa8e4b5090ce520c8c9bea92605c9d7346cf8f.png[/img]

See you in the skies,
– Tolga 🛩️

notes.title: Metal Thunder puts you in a the gunner seat of an AC-130 with progression popularised by Vampire Survivors
notes.content:
This is quite a unique experience. Merging the progression system made popular by Vampire Survivors, with the aerial combat of Call of Duty's AC-130 missions. Metal Thunder definitely has a fun idea to it.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/05/metal-thunder-puts-you-in-a-the-gunner-seat-of-an-ac-130-with-progression-popularised-by-vampire-survivors/

notes.title: Small Update v0.9.56 - The One About Endless Evolution
notes.content:
Hey Commanders!

A few new tools for those chasing pain in Endless:

Scaling Difficulty: Enemies health, damage & armor now ramp up over time. The longer you last, the worse it gets. Good luck.

No Upgrades Modifier: Turns off all upgrade choices. Pure, stripped-down survival.

All optional. All mean. All love <3

Have fun.

notes.title: Update v0.9.5 - The One That Optimized The Boom
notes.content:
[b]Commanders![/b]  
You may have noticed a flurry of updates lately—and no, I [i]definitely[/i] didn't forget to write patch notes (I’m just reading my git pushes retroactively, alright?). Here’s a tidy recap of the recent patches, fixes, and quality-of-life changes deployed over the past few updates. Thanks for your patience and all the amazing feedback—keep it coming! ❤️

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🧰 Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Fixed:[/b] Briefing on [i]Operation Dune Bastion[/i] was always skipped—now it plays as intended.
[*][b]Fixed:[/b] Enemy units now [b]freeze instantly[/b] when the game is paused, rather than slowly decelerating.
[*][b]Fixed:[/b] Game no longer [b]freezes[/b] for a moment when a new music track plays mid-game—songs now preload more gracefully. 
[*][b]Fixed:[/b] [b]Steam Cloud sync[/b] now works—turns out I [i]may[/i] have forgotten to uncheck a little beta testing box 🙃
[*][b]Fixed:[/b] Infantry units with max HP/armor no longer act like invincible raid bosses. They now go down as expected.
[*][b]Fixed:[/b] [i]No UI[/i] mode now properly hides [b]everything[/b] it should: kills, points, level counters, XP bar, subtitles, etc.
[*][b]Fixed:[/b] Modifier sliders (including weapon count) now [b]retain their values[/b] after missions.
[*][b]Fixed:[/b] Endless mode now [b]correctly grants currency[/b] post-sortie.
[*][b]Fixed:[/b] Leveling up twice at once now shows [b]both upgrade screens[/b] correctly, with the cursor present.
[*][b]Fixed:[/b] 30mm weapon upgrade stats (projectile count, max ammo) now [b]apply correctly after prestiging[/b].
[*][b]Fixed:[/b] Enemies no longer randomly stop spawning mid-sortie—spawner had been taking an unauthorized nap 💤
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🧪 Known Issues (Still under investigation)[/h2]
[list]
[*]Weapons may [b]get stuck in reload[/b] in [i]No UI[/i] mode.
[*]The [i]Decryption effect[/i] occasionally gets stuck—yes, we know, it’s becoming a meme. Fix soon™.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]⚙️ Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]QoL Feature:[/b] Added a full [b]upgrade overview menu[/b]—accessible in the pause menu and post-mission screen.
[*][b]QoL Feature:[/b] Multiple new ways to [b]zoom[/b] for better aim: W/S, mouse scroll, right click, or controller left stick.
[*][b]QoL Feature:[/b] Added a [b]Reset Progress[/b] button—for fresh starts, challenge runs, or just reliving the chaos from zero.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🚀 Performance[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Performance:[/b] Major optimization pass—especially around helicopters, rockets, ragdolls, and high-intensity moments. Up to [b]80% smoother[/b], even on Steam Deck.
[/list]

[quote][i]💡 Note: Still improving performance further; firing 20+ projectiles at once may still cause some lag, but overall things should feel noticeably smoother now.[/i][/quote]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🎴 Steam Trading Cards Are Live![/h2]
You can now earn [i]Metal Thunder[/i] [b]Steam Trading Cards[/b] just by playing. Collect them to unlock:  
[list]
[*]Badges
[*]Profile emoticons
[*]Gorgeous gunship backgrounds
[/list]  
Show off your battlefield cred on your Steam profile!

[hr][/hr]

[h2]💬 Final Notes[/h2]
Thanks to everyone who's been testing, reporting bugs, and offering suggestions. The game is shaping up better than ever because of your support—and yes, I'm still watching that economy rework 👀

Stay frosty, Commanders.  
— Tolga 🔧✨

notes.title: Update v0.9.0: "Tactical Uprising"
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Commanders,[/h1]

This update marks a major milestone for [b]Metal Thunder[/b]. Before diving into the details, I want to share a bit of the journey behind it. As a solo developer, every aspect of this game—from the crack of gunfire to the roar of new weapons—has been built with passion and persistence. But, like any battle, it hasn’t been without challenges.

Over the past few weeks, balancing game development with personal hurdles has been a real test. Survival mode has evolved into something deeper and more rewarding, but it’s taken extra time to refine. At the same time, I’ve been laying the groundwork for the campaign, making sure it delivers the tactical depth and engagement you deserve. While these challenges have stretched the timeline, they’ve also ensured that every part of [b]Metal Thunder[/b] lives up to its potential.

Your patience and support mean the world to me, and I’m incredibly grateful for it. Now, let’s dive into [b]Tactical Uprising[/b]—an update packed with tactical depth, devastating firepower, and chaotic new battlegrounds.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]⚔️ RTS Mode Enhancements[/h2]

[h3]Unit Deployment with Vanguard Points:[/h3]
Earn vanguard points during each session to deploy [b]Infantry[/b], [b]APCs[/b], [b]Tanks[/b], and [b]Helicopters[/b]. Think strategically: will you fortify your frontline or create a deadly chokehold? Every decision matters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192417/8d1e7647410dd5f68001b47763cf00f196118c54.gif[/img]

[h3]Tactical Commands:[/h3]
Take command of the battlefield with precise orders for your units. Move, attack, or retreat to defensive positions as the situation demands. The battlefield is yours—master it.

[h3]Refined AI Behavior:[/h3]
Your units are smarter and more reactive, prioritizing combat engagements when under fire. They’ll hold their ground until the threat is neutralized, ensuring your plans stay intact.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]💥 Seven New Weapons[/h2]

[p]Prepare to unleash chaos with seven powerful new weapons, each designed to bring unique tactical advantages to the battlefield. From precision strikes to overwhelming area denial, these additions make your arsenal more versatile than ever.[/p]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192417/324aba947e29908d9dd2c4a55ad9c9beb6ae9bbf.gif[/img]

[h3]Napalm[/h3]
Lock down chokepoints with a mid-sized payload that lingers to burn enemies over time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192417/f345868a5d6407a526bfab8840e283c1e2893f60.gif[/img]

[h3]Phosphorus Cluster[/h3]
Slowly expanding destruction with all munitions dropped simultaneously, perfect for suppression.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192417/2ab35e60f87b8a62fa655d59212505e6cdaa5155.gif[/img]

[h3]Cluster Bomb[/h3]
Rain small but numerous explosives across a wide radius, ideal for crowd control.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192417/3be3ea3619f5eeb6ce8289f2b94c2a64a7084119.gif[/img]

[h3]Hellfire[/h3]
Tracker rockets with mid-flight redirection for precision strikes on high-value targets.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192417/35411cfa64d4a345b1e3ddf062683b6ee64ce410.gif[/img]

[h3]Maverick[/h3]
Fire-and-forget seeker rockets that let you devastate enemies and focus on your next move.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192417/2b7acf2fbf050483b3a966e7232b1ad46e6f2ea3.gif[/img]

[h3]JDAM[/h3]
A massive gliding payload for obliterating heavily fortified targets.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192417/1d90652f25019772c3564b41f4586b9197b0bb74.gif[/img]

[h3]COMET[/h3]
Overwhelm enemies with relentless dumbfire rockets. While each payload is small, their sheer volume crushes opposition.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192417/daaa4c942fcbba8c5c0529cd6f776f809d6ada8a.gif[/img]

[p]These weapons bring new strategies to the battlefield. Experiment with them to find your edge and dominate every scenario.[/p]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]🌍 Landscapes in Progress[/h2]

[p]Creating immersive, tactical battlefields is no small task. As a solo developer, every location in [b]Metal Thunder[/b] serves as a baseline that will continue to evolve. Over time, expect more detailed, interactive environments that enhance gameplay and strategy.[/p]

[h3]Operation Iron Crucible[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192417/70c25077e4e5e0943dd8db1f4bbf2c5efba60142.gif[/img]
[p]A small industrial complex surrounded by urban buildings. Tight corridors and open loading zones create a deadly mix of cover and exposure.[/p]

[h3]Operation Thunderfield[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192417/662ed6ed04cf7e694febc99652a0307f069af3cd.gif[/img]
[p]An expansive desert airbase surrounded by desert. Vital hangars and runways force you to rely on precision and positioning.[/p]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]🔧 Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]

[h3]💀 Gore System[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192417/2565b4af484dbb9f673de1f33f8c93d469a77237.gif[/img]
Hits now create dynamic blood pools and mist, adding an extra layer of intensity to every encounter.
Whether you want the gritty realism or a cleaner experience, the gore toggle lets you customize the battlefield to your preference.

[h3]🎮 Key Glyph Integration[/h3]
A new system adapts seamlessly to your input method, displaying prompts for controllers or keyboard & mouse. It's still in early stages, so please report any bugs to help us refine it further.

[hr][/hr]
This update is just the beginning. From refining survival mode to setting the stage for a gripping campaign, I’m committed to making [b]Metal Thunder[/b] everything it can be. Thank you for being part of this journey—it means more than you know.

[h3]Let’s conquer the battlefield together.[/h3]
[b]- Dumbbell Games 💪[/b]

notes.title: Update v0.8.5 - The One About Localization
notes.content:
Hey Commanders!

A brand-new update has landed, bringing you a wave of improvements, fixes, and a special expansion that now reaches commanders worldwide. As a solo dev, I’ve poured countless hours into ensuring Metal Thunder brings the intense, gritty experience you deserve. This update wasn’t easy—it took real dedication to capture every detail in multiple languages—but I’m thrilled to finally bring this experience closer to everyone. Here’s what’s new:

[h2]🚀 Major Updates & Fixes:[/h2]

Achievements Tracking – Achievements now track progress correctly. No more missed milestones; every victory counts!
Lifetime Stats Improvements – Fixed double counting for lifetime wins/losses, making your stats more accurate than ever.
Operation Faithkeeper Spawn Points Revamp – Reworked spawn points to ensure smoother, more balanced gameplay in this key mission.
Target Damage Accuracy – Damage output now accurately adjusts for changing elevations, bringing more precision to your attacks.

[h2]📈 Quality of Life Updates:[/h2]

Vanguard Point Boosts – Now earn Vanguard Points at 5x the previous rate. Your efforts deserve rewarding!
Most Used Weapon Stats – Updated to calculate your “Most Used Weapon” based on kills rather than shots fired, focusing on true battlefield effectiveness.

[h2]🌍 Localization Update:[/h2]

After a challenging process, I’m proud to offer Metal Thunder in multiple languages, each translated with care to keep the intense spirit of the game alive. Here are the new localizations available:

German, Turkish, Chinese (Simplified & Traditional), Korean, Japanese, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), French, Polish, and Russian

Your feedback keeps me going, so please keep sharing your thoughts and victories. Take to the skies and unleash your arsenal!

- Tolga

notes.title: METAL THUNDER IS LIVE IN EARLY ACCESS!
notes.content:
Commanders, it’s time to report for duty! Metal Thunder has officially launched in Early Access, and your AC-130 gunship awaits. Take control, defend your ground, and annihilate the enemy with precision and power. But remember: this is just the beginning of the mission. We’re only getting started with an arsenal of updates and thrilling content on the horizon. Ready to see what’s next? Here’s the intel on our Content Roadmap:

[h2][b]🛠️ MISSION BRIEFING: CONTENT ROADMAP 🛠️[/b][/h2]
As we advance towards Version 1.0, here’s what you can expect on the front lines:

[h2][b]📜 CAMPAIGN MODE (Until 1.0)[/b][/h2]
Prepare for a campaign that evolves with each deployment! One week after launch, we’ll start rolling out a new campaign mission every two weeks. Each mission comes with unique challenges and specialized gameplay modes like:

[list]
[*] Time Trials – Test your speed and precision.
[*] Stealth Ops – Operate in the shadows and strike silently. …and more classified ops in store!
[/list]

[h2][b]🔥 SURVIVAL MODE (Until 1.0)[/b][/h2]
Survival Mode is the heart of Metal Thunder’s action. We’re making it even more explosive with:

[list]
[*] Ground Unit Control – Command ground forces with minor RTS elements, adding layers of strategy.
[*] Enhanced Balancing – We’re listening to your feedback to make every wave and weapon feel just right.
[*] New Maps & Locations – Fresh, themed battlefields monthly to keep you on your toes.
[*] In-Mission Objectives & Endless Mode – Achieve objectives and aim for the top of the leaderboards to prove you’re the ultimate ace.
[/list]

[h2][b]☠️ ZOMBIES MODE (1.0+)[/b][/h2]
As we approach full release, prepare to face the undead! We’re taking Metal Thunder back to WWII roots with Zombies Mode:

[list]
[*] Zombie-Themed Campaign Mode – Take on the undead hordes with high-stakes missions.
[*] New Progression Tree & Weapons – Unlock specialized weapons and upgrades.
[*] Zombie Survival Maps – Battle against waves of zombies in gritty survival maps.
[/list]

Your role in Early Access is vital, Pilots! Your feedback and field reports will help us craft the ultimate gunship experience. Stay alert for regular updates, mission drops, and more explosive content to come. Together, we’ll make Metal Thunder the most intense aerial combat experience yet.

Strap in, take command, and prepare for battle! Jump into the action NOW! 🌐 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3091340/Metal_Thunder/

[h2]Full Roadmap until 1.0[/h2]

notes.title: A Big Thank You!
notes.content:
I just want to sound off a HUGE thank you to all of you who joined the Metal Thunder squad during Steam Next Fest! You’ve been absolute AC-130 gunship pros out there, and it’s been amazing seeing you light up the battlefield.

Your feedback and enthusiasm has gotten me so excited and some feedback are like a direct hit on target – they’ve got me locked and loaded to keep making this game even better. As a solo developer, having this battalion of players behind me is the ultimate air support. Together, we’ll make Metal Thunder a force to be reckoned with!

From the bottom of heart, I salute you. You’ve got my six, and I’ve got more firepower on the way. Stay frosty, keep those skies clear, and let’s make some noise together!

Signing off
- Tolga
